uniform_claim: For a fixed onto S3 transposition colouring, let ell be the binary scalar root-cocycle dimension and h=ell-2. A transitive rank2-common-form affine representation in dimension k projecting to this colouring exists iff h>=k-1, k>=2. Maximal dimension is ell-1 when h>0; all such transitive images have order24*8^(k-2). Relate ell=2+b1 of its simple three-sheeted branched cover.
proof_gates: Trivial radical extensions preserve admissible cocycle spaces, using H1(knot group;R)=R and H2(knot group;R)=0
Dependent radical/translation classes yield an explicit invariant quadratic function
Independent classes restrict to independent S3-equivariant maps on the colouring kernel; H1(S3,F2^2)=0 and End_S3(F2^2)=F2 force full joint image; commutators yield every radical translation
